2 briefings, about 11 minutes in all. Each one is the five-to-seven-minute spoken version of a lesson: the scenario, the ideas that matter, the rule in plain words, and what to do on Monday. The lesson pages stay the reference.

## Put them in your podcast app

Copy this feed address: **`https://wirsteve.github.io/isoe-school/podcast.xml`**

- **Apple Podcasts (iPhone):** open the Library tab, tap the three-dot menu at the top, choose *Follow a Show by URL*, and paste the address.
- **Overcast:** tap **+**, then *Add URL*, and paste the address.
- **Pocket Casts:** tap Search and paste the address.

Episodes are numbered in curriculum order. New briefings show up automatically as lessons are added.
